title.ja: 初心者にオススメの戦法

intro.ja:
居飛車は飛車を２筋に残し、飛車と角を同じ方面で働かせる。振り飛車は飛車を左へ移し、空いた右側に玉を囲う。最初は両方を同時に暗記するより、一方の基本形と攻守の役割を理解しよう。居飛車なら矢倉、振り飛車なら四間飛車が入口になる。

相手も自分と同じ戦法を選ぶとは限らない。居飛車なら対振り飛車と角換わり、振り飛車なら相振り飛車と角交換への対応も順に学ぶ。角道を閉じても相手の手順次第では角交換を避けられない。囲いと棒銀など一つの攻め筋をセットで練習し、実戦で崩れた場所を復習しよう。
intro.en:
Choose a family by how you want to coordinate the rook and king. Static Rook keeps the rook on the second file and develops an attack alongside the bishop; Ranging Rook moves it left and usually castles right. Start with Yagura or Fourth-file Rook, learning where each attacking and defending piece belongs rather than collecting opening names.

Your opponent determines the next branch. Static Rook players also need anti-ranging development and Bishop Exchange; ranging players need Double Ranging Rook and bishop-exchange responses. A closed bishop diagonal simplifies some positions but does not guarantee a quiet game. Pair one castle with one attack, then review the first point where an opponent prevented your intended formation.

question.ja: 四間飛車を覚えれば、相手が振り飛車でも同じ囲いでよい？
question.en: Can a Fourth-file Rook player use identical development against a ranging opponent?

answer.ja: 相振り飛車では攻めの方向が変わる。対居飛車用の美濃囲いを機械的に使わず、相振りの駒組みを別に学ぶ。
answer.en: No. Double Ranging Rook changes the attack direction; learn its formations instead of automatically repeating anti-Static Rook development.

courses.title: 初心者にオススメの戦法: 居飛車 飛車と角が同じ方向に
courses.titleEn: Choosing your first opening: Static Rook: rook and bishop face the same direction
courses.goalFormation:
居飛車 飛車と角が同じ方向に
居飛車は、飛車を2筋(後手なら8筋)から動かさずに戦う戦法で、攻撃力が高いのが特徴です。飛車と角が同じ方向に利くので大駒でどんどん攻められます。一方で玉を囲うのが難しく、右に囲うと飛車が、左に囲うと角が邪魔になります。攻撃重視で守りが薄くなりがちなので、激しく戦いたい人に向きます。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Static Rook: rook and bishop face the same direction
Static Rook keeps the rook on the 2nd file (the 8th for White) and fights from there; its strength is attacking power. The rook and bishop work in the same direction, so major pieces can attack aggressively. The drawback is that building a castle is hard: castling to the right gets in the rook's way, and castling to the left gets in the bishop's way. It is attack-oriented with thin defense, suiting players who want fierce fights.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

courses.title: 初心者にオススメの戦法: 振り飛車 飛車と角の方向がバラバラ
courses.titleEn: Choosing your first opening: Ranging Rook: rook and bishop face different directions
courses.goalFormation:
振り飛車 飛車と角の方向がバラバラ
振り飛車は、飛車を一度左側に動かしてから戦う戦法です。飛車と角が別々の方向を向くので、攻めるのには向きませんが、飛車も角もいない右側に玉を囲うので守りをがっちり固められます。振り飛車ではしっかり守ってから戦えます。居飛車・振り飛車のどちらでも、角交換をするかどうかで戦い方が大きく変わります。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Ranging Rook: rook and bishop face different directions
Ranging Rook moves the rook to the left side before fighting. The rook and bishop point in different directions, so it is less suited to aggressive attacks, but the king castles on the right side where neither rook nor bishop sits, giving a solid defense. You can defend firmly before fighting. Within both Static Rook and Ranging Rook, whether the bishops are exchanged greatly changes the play.
